description: Basic information about a grid session.

sessionId.description: The unique sessionId that identifies the grid session.

startedBy.description: The user that started this session.

startedOn.description: The date-time when the session was started.

modifiedOn.description: The date-time when the session was last changed.

lastReplicaIdClient.description: The last replica ID issued to a client. Client replica IDs are incremented.

lastReplicaIdService.description: The last replica ID issued to a service. Service replica IDs are decremented.

gridJsonSchema$Id.description: The $id of the JSON schema that will be used for model validation in this grid session.

sourceEntityId.description: The synId of the table/view/csv that this grid was cloned from.
